decode.full: Record layout is known and checked against the shipped corpus. No unexplained spans in the supported path.
decode.partial: The primary payload is decoded, but variants, later LODs, or regions of the file remain unmodelled.
decode.surface: Strings, references, and headers are recovered. The record layout is not parsed.

write.full: CDMW can produce game-loadable bytes for this format.
write.constrained: Only edits proven safe are permitted; the rest are gated off deliberately.

origin.proprietary: Pearl Abyss format. Everything known about it was reverse engineered here.
origin.third_party: Licensed middleware format (Havok, Wwise). Documented externally, not by the game.
origin.open: Public format with a published specification.
origin.unknown: Provenance unconfirmed; may not be engine content.

priority.high: Closing this gap unlocks a modding category that is currently at zero.
priority.medium: Real value, but a workaround or an adjacent format covers part of it.
priority.low: Rare, cosmetic, or already served by another route.

weights.note: Coverage percentages are the weighted mean of these per-entry scores, so they move only when a status moves.

headline.note: Engine formats are the ones CDMW had to reverse engineer. Open formats are counted separately because decoding them is not the project's work.
